main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads matrix size n, fills an n by n matrix with sequential values, then reads n*n integers p, zeroes each corresponding matrix cell, and for each interior cell accumulates the minimum number of non-zero cells above, below, left, and right, finally printing the accumulated total." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read integer n from standard input using scanf("%d", &n). RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Declare long variables p, k, and cnt; initialize k to 1 and cnt to 0. RESULT p,k,cnt]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1, for j from 0 to n-1, assign a[i][j] = k and then increment k by 1. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For ii from 0 to n*n-1, read a long value p from standard input using scanf("%ld", &p). RESULT p]
            [COMMAND Within the ii loop, if 1 <= p && n >= p (top row), set a[0][p-1] = 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the ii loop, else if n*n >= p && n*n - n + 1 <= p (bottom row), set a[n-1][n - n*n + p - 1] = 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the ii loop, else if p % n == 0 (right column), set a[(p/n) - 1][n-1] = 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the ii loop, else if p % n == 1 (left column), set a[p/n][0] = 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the ii loop, for the remaining interior-cell case, set a[p/n][(p%n)-1] = 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Still in the interior-cell case, assign i = p/n and j = (p%n)-1, and initialize long m[5] = {i, n-1-i, j, n-1-j}. RESULT i,j,m]
            [COMMAND Still in the interior-cell case, scan upward with jj from 0 to i-1 and decrement m[0] whenever a[jj][j] == 0. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Still in the interior-cell case, scan downward with jj from n-1 down to i+1 and decrement m[1] whenever a[jj][j] == 0. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Still in the interior-cell case, scan left with jj from 0 to j-1 and decrement m[2] whenever a[i][jj] == 0. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Still in the interior-cell case, scan right with jj from n-1 down to j+1 and decrement m[3] whenever a[i][jj] == 0. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Still in the interior-cell case, sort m's first four elements in ascending order using qsort(m, 4, sizeof(long), compare_int). RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Still in the interior-cell case, set long mm = m[0] and add mm to cnt. RESULT cnt]
            [COMMAND After the ii loop, print cnt with printf("%ld\n", cnt) and return 0. RESULT cnt]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
